task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:
You've entered a kitchen.

You scan the room for a fridge, and you find a fridge. You see a closed oven right there by you. You make out a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a counter. On the counter you can see a red apple, a raw purple potato, a raw red potato, a cookbook and a knife. You can see a stove. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is a closed plain door leading north. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, there is no door.

You scan the room for a fridge, and you find a fridge. You see a closed oven right there by you. You make out a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a counter. On the counter you can see a raw red potato and a cookbook. You can see a stove. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is a closed plain door leading north. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, there is no door.

There is a fried red apple, a raw yellow potato, a red onion, a red hot pepper and a white onion on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a knife, a sliced roasted banana, a chopped fried purple potato, a sliced roasted orange bell pepper and a chopped fried yellow bell pepper.

feedback: You drop the knife on the ground.
